rationale.conceptual: The method (GGA+U) is an established approach, but applying it correctly to these specific systems—setting up spin configurations, using Ueff=7 eV on N-2p, comparing FM and AFM energies, and extracting local magnetic moments—requires non-trivial understanding of DFT and plane-wave codes. It is not a novel custom algorithm but goes beyond a simple textbook operation.
rationale.execution: The workflow comprises at least four distinct stages: constructing initial structures, relaxing geometries with PBE, performing GGA+U single-point calculations for FM and AFM configurations, and extracting data into JSON. Setting up Quantum ESPRESSO and managing these steps with correct parameters constitutes a moderate multi-stage pipeline, though all steps are scriptable.
